evidence.rationale: Native checkpoint capacity comes from pinned config.json. 8K working context selected from the November 3 comparison: 192-message continuity was correct and avoided expensive summaries, with about 31 MiB additional peak MLX allocation. A larger forced-compaction case still exceeded the 60-second turn deadline; this is not a long-history latency guarantee. Task decoding otherwise preserves the committed baseline. Prefill delegates to the pinned runtime. Application choices and limitations are documented in docs/reports/agent-profiles-2026-11-03.md. November 4 native cache readiness: enable one exact-prefix snapshot, capped at 2048 tokens and 128 MiB of logical state arrays. Ten matched warm pairs improved median first text from 2.338 to 1.008 seconds. Native recurrent-state, cancellation, release and memory checks passed. A discovered empty-versus-absent tool-schema mismatch was fixed centrally before rerunning production workflows; the formerly rejected late call now reaches the existing application quota handling. See docs/reports/model-readiness-2026-11-04.md for task limitations and initial preparation costs.
